rootCauseOneLine: ThreadDetailView mounts ~12-15 independent per-thread queries with nothing deferred, and useEnvironmentWorkStatus (staleTime 0, refetchOnMount "always") / useEnvironmentPullRequest (refetchOnMount, refetchOnWindowFocus "always") drive uncached server->daemon git and `gh pr view` probes (70-260 ms git, 1.1-1.6 s GitHub API) on every open, forming a 3-tier waterfall.
proposedFix: (1) Cache workspace.status in the host daemon per environment, invalidated by the existing WatchManager work-status-changed/git-refs-changed events and daemon-owned mutations, with a short TTL and coalescing (daemon-internal, no protocol bump). (2) Stop probing GitHub per open: useEnvironmentPullRequest -> refetchOnMount false, drop refetchOnWindowFocus "always", refresh on git-refs-changed only, and memoize the last gh pr view result per branch in the daemon. (3) Gate status/PR queries, thread-storage listing, tabs, and fork/parent child-thread lists on the surface that renders them being open (none visible on mobile first paint). (4) Fix the double status refetch per open. Do not add an aggregate bootstrap endpoint (rejected history in #335/#1470/#1481).
caveats: Measured in dev mode (Vite, StrictMode double-fires, HTTP/1.1 proxy) with a 1-message thread; distinct-URL counts (12-15) are slightly below the issue's ~19 and depend on the thread's tabs/panels. Mobile RTT was emulated via CDP in headless Chromium, not a real iPhone; the reporter's 3-15 s taps over a Cloudflare tunnel were not reproduced on-device. The pull-request timing used a scratch repo pointed at github.com/get-bb/bb (gh returns absent after a real API call). The dev-browser sandbox could not apply throttling, so the throttled run uses a plain-node Playwright script.
